text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: —Uwoooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Aah— I'll never forget this—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (This music, today————)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(...To be able to hold a session with 
everyone... To share the same generation 
with all of you... I'm so truly glad.)

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
—Why are you wallowing in your own world 
all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that the kind of thing you're 
supposed to do together?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, my dear friends.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Everyoone!! That was an awesome race!! It 
got so fiery out there!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super looking forward to your next 
race tooーー!! Thanks for an amazing 
raceーー!"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Haha— We really owe it all to Earth-kun.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It was the same during the Derby. 
Earth was always there, firing up our 
races...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Not yet, you two.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's too early to be satisfied...! Our 
race has merely reached one milestone!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, it is the first movement!! From 
here, the music shall truly begin!!”

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Even when we reach the Senior Year, let's 
keep putting on even greater races 
together, always!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: If it's us, we can do it!!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: ...That's so like Earth, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Earth-kun is right! Our generation can 
still shine on and on and on!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
All right!! Let's sing!!! Sing these 
feelings loud and proud!!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: "Huh, s-singing!? Right now!?"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Laaaaa-la-laaaaa~♪♪ We are~~~~ the Golden 
Generation~~~~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Laaa—La Laaaa—♪♪ We aaaare~~~~ the 
generation that composes music~~~~♪♪"

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
La, laaa-la-laaaa!! We are—the one and 
only generation—!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they're singing something! This 
generation is so fun!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at it makes me feel kind of 
fond of it~.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ……No, that's not it……—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Against me... Against 'her' and my Kikuka 
Sho...—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's totally... different... I never meant 
to... like that—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I couldn't laugh...! Not at all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Kikuka Sho became a race that 
stood as the crowning culmination of 
Sounds of Earth's generation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a meeting to decide Sounds of Earth's 
future goals, I decided to propose what I 
had been thinking about for some time.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! The traditional, longest-distance 
GⅠ race, huh...?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is a GI turf race 
over 3,200 meters, held at Kyoto 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's Sounds of Earth, who fully 
demonstrated their ability even in the 
3,000m Kikuka Sho, they'll surely run a 
great race...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we'll be fighting right 
away! Against her, the one running the 
most fiercely right now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I immediately knew which Umamusume Sounds 
of Earth was referring to as "her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship, the unpredictable Umamusume who 
captivates fans with her wild, 
unconventional racing style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her behavior might always be erratic, but 
her skill is unmistakably top-class in 
this era...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I respect that strength, but I have 
no fear of it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I can't wait! I'm so eager 
to hear what kind of music will be made 
once we reach the Senior Class and clash 
with the older generation!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This side of Sounds of Earth is truly 
dependable. That said, I want to make sure 
we're thoroughly prepared to win—
choice_data_list:
Let's run the Nikkei Sho before the Tenno 
Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's an important GII race used as a 
stepping stone to the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod in agreement. In this 2,500m turf 
GII race held at Nakayama Racecourse, I 
want her to gain valuable race experience 
for the Senior Class—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's make the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
our goal and aim for the Nikkei Sho 
first!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I'm already looking forward to next 
year...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the first goal for the Senior 
Class was successfully decided...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(The music of our generation is precious. 
It is a lovable brilliance uniquely our 
own.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Meanwhile——)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(There is music that can only be born by 
mingling with other generations.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(And it is precisely in a race that 
transcends generations...—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(She has the power to whip everyone into a 
frenzy—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I can't wait...! For the future...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The score continues still, and the melody 
plays on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No one has stepped down from the stage. 
If anything— a brand-new stage is about to 
begin."
